How we work together

You know what you’re getting before you pay.

We talk about your goals

You tell us what you want to sell and who you want to sell to. If you already have a store, we go through it and note what is costing you sales.

You get a plan

For a new store, a clear plan covering products, market and pricing. For an existing one, a short video showing the problems and how we’d fix them.

We agree the scope

You pick the services you need, and we agree what’s included and the price.

We deliver and report

We do the work, hand it over, and send a short report on what we did and what to test next.

Questions people ask

Straight answers before you message us.

Can you set up my store from scratch?

Yes. We can handle the research, the product listings and the website design, from your first product to a store that’s ready to sell. If you already have a store, we can fix or improve it instead.

Can you guarantee sales?

We can’t promise a number of sales, because results depend on your products, prices and the traffic you bring, and anyone who does is guessing. What we commit to is the work: researched properly, set up carefully, and a clear report on what we did.

How long does a project take?

It depends on the services you pick and the amount of custom work. We’ll give you a timeline once we’ve seen what you need.

Are hosting and app costs included?

No. Hosting, domains, store subscriptions and third-party apps are billed at cost or paid by you directly. Our fee covers the research, setup, design and support.

Can I hire you for just one thing?

Yes. You can hire us for research, listings, a website, a fix or maintenance on its own.

How do we get started?

Message us on WhatsApp. Tell us what you want to sell, or send your store link, and we’ll tell you what we’d do first.
